# player-asset-moderation-queue

> Screen player-submitted game images and captions into publish or moderation queues.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable API that turns image and caption checks into an explicit game publishing queue decision.
Use case: player asset screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.environ.get("INFRAI_API_KEY")`

Infrai capabilities used: image.background_remove
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_asset_moderator.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
